examples.english: This victory is thanks to the effort of the entire team.

notes:
{勝|か}ち is a noun meaning win or victory. It comes from the verb ⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to win).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {勝|か}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧ (to achieve victory - formal)
- {勝|か}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ (to be obsessed with winning)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勝|か}ち (... wins / victory goes to ...)
- ⟦{大勝|たいしょう}ち→大勝ち：noentry⟧ (big win)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ (loss, defeat)

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to win)

COMPOUND EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{負|ま}け→勝ち負け：11928_kachimake⟧ (winning and losing)
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{残|のこ}る→勝ち残る：noentry⟧ (to survive by winning)
